title: Fourier Tail Bound by Total Influence
statement: For every $n,k\in\mathbb N$ and every $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$, the Fourier weight on levels strictly above $k$ satisfies $\displaystyle\sum_{S\subseteq[n],\ |S|>k}\widehat f(S)^2\le\frac{I[f]}{k+1}$, where $I[f]$ is the sum of the coordinate influences.
replaced: For every $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\bbr$ and $k\in\mathbb N$, $\sum_{|S|>k}\widehat f(S)^2\le I(f)/(k+1)$, where $I(f)=\sum_S|S|\widehat f(S)^2$ is total influence.
